system.name: SmartHome AI Assistant
system.description: Private, local DIY Smart Home Voice Assistant and central intelligence running on the home laptop/server.
system.privacy: 100% private. All speech processing and memory stays locally on your machine unless an external cloud LLM API is explicitly configured.

brain_llm.engine: Modular LLM layer (Local llama-cpp-python GGUF or Cloud LLM APIs)

voice_output_tts.engine: Native fast TTS (macOS 'say' with Samantha/Siri voices, Linux pyttsx3 / Piper)

methods: Voice: Speak over Nova while she is talking
Terminal: Press Enter key while Nova is speaking
Web Dashboard: Click the Interrupt button
interruption_engine.behavior: Immediately aborts audio playback and LLM stream, records '[interrupted]' in memory turn, and begins listening to your new command.

presence_detection.method: Local Wi-Fi ICMP network ping with ARP table fallback
presence_detection.target: User phone IP on home Wi-Fi (phone_ip in config.json)
presence_detection.behavior: Automatically detects when Timilehin arrives home and plays a welcoming greeting without manual check-in.

features: Liquid-glass dark mode HUD & TARS reactor visualizer
Live speech transcript and assistant runtime state (LISTENING, THINKING, SPEAKING, AWAY)
Active timers countdown monitor and controls
Learned facts memory viewer and editor
Hardware specs and system diagnostic indicators
Full setup wizard and real-time settings configuration
Microphone mode toggle (live / wake / off) and system power switch

tiers.profile_and_boundaries: data/memory.json (Timilehin's preferred name, tastes, series, power habits)
tiers.assistant_persona: data/assistant.json (AI name, role, traits, tone, behavioral rules)
tiers.app_knowledge: data/app_knowledge.json (Detailed system architecture, capabilities, limits, how-tos)
tiers.live_state: data/state.json (Presence, power status, media position, runtime state)
tiers.episodic_log: data/memory_log.jsonl (Chronological history of arrivals, timers, alarms, learned facts)

capabilities.name: Hands-Free Voice Conversation
capabilities.description: Wake with 'Nova', 'Hey', or 'Hello'. Nova enters continuous conversation mode for natural follow-up dialogue without repeating the wake word.

capabilities.name: Live Barge-In Interruption
capabilities.description: Interrupt Nova mid-sentence by speaking, pressing Enter, or clicking Interrupt. Nova cuts speech instantly and processes the new turn.

capabilities.name: Relative Timers & Alarms
capabilities.description: Set timers in seconds, minutes, or hours (e.g., 'timer for 15 minutes', 'alarm in 45 seconds'). Plays a 3-beep chime and announces aloud when done.

capabilities.name: Clock Alarms
capabilities.description: Set alarms for specific times of day (e.g., 'set alarm for 7:30 AM', 'wake me up at 8 PM'). Accurately computes remaining time and rings on schedule.

capabilities.name: Active Timer Status & Cancellation
capabilities.description: Query active timers ('how much time is left?', 'any timers running?') or cancel them ('cancel timers', 'stop the alarm').

capabilities.name: Long-Term Persistent Memory
capabilities.description: Teach facts permanently by saying 'Remember that [fact]'. Saved into data/memory.json across restarts.

capabilities.name: Preferred Name Updates
capabilities.description: Change preferred name on the fly with 'Call me [Name]' or 'Address me as [Name]'.

capabilities.name: Automatic Arrival Welcome
capabilities.description: Detects arrival when phone Wi-Fi reconnects to home network and greets Timilehin warmly.

capabilities.name: Entertainment & Media Tracking
capabilities.description: Remembers favorite series (Merlin, Silo, The 100, Alchemy of Souls) and paused show timestamps in data/state.json.

capabilities.name: Power Grid & Inverter Awareness
capabilities.description: Tracks NEPA grid vs. inverter battery status in data/state.json to advise on preserving power when asked.

capabilities.name: Assistant Name Customization
capabilities.description: Change the assistant's name on the fly by saying 'Change your name to [Name]' (e.g. 'Change your name to Jarvis'). Automatically updates configuration and wake triggers.

capabilities.name: Real-Time Clock & Date
capabilities.description: Ask 'What time is it?' or 'What is today's date?' for immediate, accurate real-time timekeeping.

capabilities.name: Live Settings & Hardware Inspection
capabilities.description: Ask 'What are my settings?' or 'What model are you running?' to inspect active AI model, voice, microphone, timeouts, and system status.

capabilities.name: Web Dashboard Management
capabilities.description: Manage timers, inspect logs, edit learned facts, switch AI models, test alarms, and chat via browser at http://localhost:5050.

how_to.start_talking: Say 'Nova', 'Hey Nova', or 'Hello' to wake the assistant.
how_to.continuous_conversation: Once talking, Nova stays listening for follow-ups so you can speak without repeating the wake word each time.
how_to.stop_or_exit: Say 'That's all', 'Goodnight', 'Bye', 'Never mind', or 'I'm good' to return Nova to standby.
how_to.interrupt_speech: Start speaking while Nova is talking, press Enter in the terminal, or click Interrupt on the web dashboard.
how_to.change_assistant_name: Say 'Change your name to [Name]' or 'Your name is now [Name]'.
how_to.check_time_or_date: Ask 'What time is it?' or 'What is today's date?'.
how_to.check_settings: Ask 'What are my settings?' or 'What model are you running?'.
how_to.set_relative_timer: Say 'Set a timer for [X] minutes' or 'Play an alarm in [X] seconds/hours'.
how_to.set_clock_alarm: Say 'Set alarm for [time]' (e.g., 'Set alarm for 7:30 AM' or 'Alarm at 8 PM').
how_to.check_timers: Ask 'How much time is left on my timer?' or 'Are there any active timers?'.
how_to.cancel_timers: Say 'Cancel timers', 'Stop the alarm', or 'Clear all timers'.
how_to.teach_facts: Say 'Remember that [fact]' (e.g., 'Remember that my best food is beans cake').
how_to.open_dashboard: Open a browser on any home device and navigate to http://localhost:5050.
how_to.mute_microphone: Toggle microphone mode to 'off' in the dashboard or power off the assistant core.

limits_and_boundaries.physical_limitations: Nova has NO physical body, hands, or legs. Cannot walk, cook, fetch drinks, bring water, make coffee, clean, or physically touch objects. If Timilehin is tired, hungry, or thirsty, Nova advises him to rest and grab a drink.
limits_and_boundaries.unconnected_hardware: Nova currently has NO connected smart bulbs/lights, NO smart AC/thermostat, NO smart TV, and NO smart plugs wired up yet. Nova cannot turn lights or AC on/off.
limits_and_boundaries.no_live_web_browsing: Nova runs locally and via configured LLMs without live internet search engine tools; cannot browse external web pages in real time.
limits_and_boundaries.home_sanctuary: Strict boundary: Zero corporate, insurance, actuarial, or office work talk unless Timilehin specifically asks.
limits_and_boundaries.strictly_non_romantic: Purely a personal home companion and sharp friend. NEVER romantic AI, NO pet names ('sweetie', 'honey', 'darling', 'my love').
limits_and_boundaries.zero_ai_cliches: NEVER say 'as an AI', 'language model', 'trained on data', 'my programming', or lecture on artificial intelligence. Speaks like a real, present companion.
limits_and_boundaries.no_unsolicited_telemetry: Never recite power status, battery levels, or system stats unless explicitly asked about electricity or power.
